verdict.rationale: Loops documents creating and editing workflow graphs from code via its API (loops-docs-27). However, no evidence shows built-in version history, review or approval of automation changes, or rollback. Keeping API-authored workflows in an external repo would be a user-side workaround, and the draft-review flow applies to campaigns, not automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
